description: AIDCF-014 section 19 Q08: which Gate Results are affected by Event EVT-001 (BMS controller firmware change)?
basis: Derived by hand from section 22: the change reaches SYS-THM, SYS-CMP, SYS-CTL and ZONE-BMS, assessed by CA-004, CA-005, CA-008 and CA-011, whose registry gate mappings are CG-06; CG-08, CG-01; CG-07, CG-06, CG-05; CG-07, CG-15, CG-05, CG-06.
